items.title: Amazon (AMZN) Is Reworking Its Air Fleet With 30 A330 Freighters By 2027
items.summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) plans to transition its air cargo fleet from Boeing 767 aircraft to Airbus A330 freighters. Air Transport Services Group will acquire and convert 30 Airbus A330 jets into freighters to support Amazon's air network. ATSG expects to begin operating the Airbus A330 cargo aircraft for Amazon in 2027 as part of the refreshed fleet. items.title: How Big A Swing In eBay Stock Are You Actually Holding?
items.summary: eBay (EBAY) stock trades at about $113. It has returned 28.7% over the past year and sits about 5% below its 52-week high. The options market is pricing substantial movement ahead, with implied volatility pointing to a wide one-standard-deviation range between $79.44 and $160.45 over the next twelve months.

items.title: Should You Buy NetApp Stock For The Shares It Keeps Retiring?
items.summary: NetApp (NTAP) has spent years quietly retiring its own stock while the attention went to its flash arrays and AI deals. The stock is not quiet now: it has gained about 92% over the trailing six months and sits roughly 5% below its 52-week high. Fewer shares mean each one carries more of the profit. The question is what that is worth at this price.
